no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: STAAR Surgical is a pure-play ophthalmic medical device company (Implantable Collamer Lenses for refractive vision correction). All revenue (~100% FY2025) comes from already-approved/marketed ICL products. The company describes its 'innovation pipeline' in commercial terms - geographic launches (EVO+ in China) and lens-size line extensions - rather than investigational P1/P2/P3 programs. No interventional P1/P2/P3 trials are listed with STAAR as lead sponsor on ClinicalTrials.gov. R&D spend is for post-approval studies, line extensions, and tools (e.g., AI lens-sizing) supporting marketed devices. The Alcon merger (announced Aug 2025) was terminated by stockholder vote on January 6, 2026.
